Services

Practical service for the repairs your vehicle needs most.

Most work is completed where your vehicle is parked. Final pricing depends on the vehicle, condition, access and work required.

◉From $300

Full Brake Job

Labour for front and rear pads and rotors, including cleaning and anti-seize where appropriate. Parts are separate.

⌁From $80

General Diagnostics

Assessment of warning lights, strange noises, leaks, drivability concerns and other vehicle problems.

●From $100

Oil Change

Full synthetic oil and a quality new filter, with professional disposal of used oil.

❄From $140

AC Service

Air-conditioning diagnosis and recharge service where appropriate. Refrigerant and parts are separate.

↕From $80

Suspension

Diagnosis and replacement of common suspension components, including links, control arms, struts and related parts.

◎From $80

Tire Services

Seasonal wheel changes and common tire services. Tires, valves, weights and materials are separate.

▣From $80

Battery Replacement

Battery testing and replacement. The battery and additional parts are separate.

✦From $120

Spark Plugs

Spark-plug replacement for many vehicles. Pricing can change when major disassembly is required.

∞From $80

Serpentine Belt

Belt inspection and replacement, including checks for common causes of wear or failure.

▲From $150

Roadside Assistance

Mobile help for eligible breakdowns. Parts, towing and additional travel are separate.

＋From $80

Other Services

Need something not listed? Send your vehicle information and a description of the problem.

Pricing note: Prices shown are starting prices in Canadian dollars and may be labour-only. Parts, fluids, refrigerant, tires, batteries and materials may be additional. Final pricing is confirmed after reviewing the vehicle and requested work.

How it works

A simpler way to get your vehicle serviced.

Your requested time is not confirmed until Habibi Auto reviews the service details, travel distance and availability.

1

Send your request

Tell us about your vehicle, the service you need and where it is located.

2

We confirm the details

3

We come to you

About Habibi Auto

Local, mobile and built around convenience.

Habibi Auto Service is a family-run mobile mechanic business serving London, Ontario and surrounding communities. Our lead mechanic has nearly a decade of automotive experience, including five years specializing in Mercedes-Benz at MB Master.

We created Habibi Auto to offer customers a more convenient, straightforward and personal way to maintain and repair their vehicles.

  • Mobile service at your location
  • Experience across many makes and models
  • Appointment details confirmed before service
  • Starting prices clearly explained
